name: buffalo-conditional-representation-validation
instr:
Buffalo cannot conditionally validate rendered HTTP representations before expensive rendering or stream consumption. Add opt-in conditional validation whose validators identify the actual output, while preserving existing behavior when renderers or applications do not participate.

Every built-in renderer, including String, JSON, XML, Func, Template, and Download, must expose metadata truthful to its eventual bytes and content type. String and Template validators must reflect data, localization, helpers, layouts, resolved sources, and every other caller-visible output influence. Downloads must retain attachment metadata and consume one-shot readers at most once. Validate matching downloads before consuming their readers, and return an empty conditional response. Func remains non-validatable unless configured with consistent caller-supplied metadata; metadata failures must bypass the body callback and follow the existing rendering error outcome.

Make conditional handling opt-in per render Options. Disabled engines and legacy Renderer implementations must retain Context.Render behavior unchanged. With the default policy, conditional headers must not alter body delivery, session persistence, or flash handling.
